groups.activity: spawn a Sister whose Hound has the Dorma Model
groups.meta: Nightmare Granum Void, a Sister per Candidate

rows.label: Sister Candidate
rows.note: any weapon; her Hound's Model is rolled when you Mercy her, one of three

conditions: Open the Nightmare Granum Void and inspect Sister Candidates.

Kill the Treasurer when it appears. Spend the Crown at a Golden Hand Tribute, then kill 25 Errant Specters (25 more per extra squadmate) for Nightmare Rank 1. A Candidate then appears on the Corpus Ship.
Only the last player to damage her can Mercy her, so run solo. You cannot Mercy while any Lich, Sister, or Coda is active. A Candidate can flee, so catch her first.

disclosures.title: the fast Sister loop
disclosures.body: Solo, normal, not Steel Path, Capture on Hydra, Pluto. A squad raises the kill requirement inside the Granum Void by 25 per player, so run it alone. Waypoint a Golden Hand Tribute first, kill the capture target, then come back and offer the Zenith crown; if no Tribute has shown up halfway through the tile, restart, and a Tribute within roughly 200m of extraction can mean the Candidate never spawns. Inside the Void, Xoris heavy attacks charge it; detonating it on a captive Solaris adds 20 seconds, and Specter Particles add 5. Kill the Treasurer every cycle for the next crown, and hit Replay on the end screen to re-run.

groups.activity: get Requiem mods: crack Requiem relics
groups.meta: Requiem Eterna Relics, 3 mods per Sister

rows.label: Oull
rows.alt: when you land the full correct sequence, 25% to drop

conditions: A Kuva Flood always drops an Eterna Relic, and each of your Sister's Hounds has a 5% chance to drop a Requiem Relic.
Open them in a Requiem Fissure on the Kuva Fortress. They cannot be refined with Void Traces and hold only the eight Requiem mods, never Oull.
Each solved sequence uses one charge from every equipped mod. A mod with no charges is Defiled and unusable.
Palladino sells the retired Requiem I-IV relics for 10 Riven Slivers each, 10 per week of each.

groups.meta: Mercy Hounds, reveal all 3 Requiems, then find their order

rows.label: revealed Requiems
rows.note: Murmurs reveal the mods, not their order

rows.label: correct Parazon sequence
rows.note: sends the Sister to Neptune Proxima

conditions: Mercy Hounds on your Sister's nodes. Each one adds a Murmur and fills her rage meter.
Do not stab your Sister until one Requiem is revealed. After that, equip the known mods on your Parazon and stab every time she is down.
A wrong stab stops at the first wrong mod, ranks the Sister up (Venus, Phobos, Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto), and gives the squad 10 Murmurs.
Kill her Hound before her health runs out; a Hound alive at that point self-destructs and gives no Murmur.
Each node under her influence takes about 0.7% of your mission credits. You get it all back when she is defeated.
Let her stumble three times without stabbing and she leaves without ranking up.
bonuses: Each stab makes her drop 7,000 to 10,000 credits.
A Requiem Ultimatum forces your Sister out on one of her nodes. Palladino sells one a week for 10 Riven Slivers; use it solo, since a squad can spawn a teammate's Sister instead.

disclosures.title: the safe four-stab routine
disclosures.body: Put the first revealed Requiem in slot 1 with any two others behind it. If the stab fails, move it to slot 2, then slot 3. Put each later reveal in the first slot not ruled out. The fourth stab is guaranteed.

disclosures.title: the same routine with Oull
disclosures.body: Put Oull in slot 1 and the first known Requiem in slot 2; swap them if it fails. If the known one failed slot 1, move it to slot 3. Put the second reveal in the first unknown slot, and move it to slot 2 if it fails. The last stab fixes the order. Replace Oull with the third reveal once you have it.

rows.label: Dorma Hound
rows.note: on her own prebuilt Hound, or as her random component blueprint

conditions: Clear the crewships and Security Nodes, board her ship, kill her Hound and two Warframe Specters, then beat her single health bar.
Choose Vanquish, never Convert: a converted Sister hands over no Hound and no component blueprint. No choice within 20 seconds Vanquishes.
Check her Hound's Model once she appears; only a Dorma Hound is this one.
The Confrontation node needs one Railjack Intrinsic at rank 3.
bonuses: Everything she taxed comes back, and every squad member gets a Corrupted Holokey.
Each vanquish also hands over her Tenet weapon, whatever Model her Hound carries.
Every vanquish also drops one random Hound component blueprint.

disclosures.title: you don't need to build one
disclosures.body: The prebuilt Hound a vanquished Sister leaves in your Foundry works exactly like one you build, including for Mastery once gilded. Check which Model each new Sister's Hound carries before committing to the fight. If you build from a dropped blueprint, the Dorma Model costs 50,000 credits, 5 Spectral Debris, 5 Gallium, 2 Radian Sentirum and 10 Mirewinder Parallel Biodes over 24h, and you still need a Core, Bracket and Stabilizer, each its own Sister blueprint drop.

conditions: Claiming needs two free Companion slots: one for the Hound and one for its Batoten.

rows.label: Solaris United standing
rows.note: 71,000 for the rank-ups to Doer, 5,000 for the gild
rows.alt: or sell raw gems to Smokefinger

rows.label: Training Debt-Bond
rows.note: 6 across the rank-ups, 10 for the gild

conditions: Conservation, plus Bounty 1 for the bonds.
Doer is the rank gilding needs; ranking further to Cove buys nothing this plan needs.
Level the Hound to rank 30 first. Gilding resets it to rank 0, and the Model's Mastery counts from the second climb.
An ungilded Hound earns no Mastery for its Model.
Mastery is per Model: once a gilded Hound with this Model hits 30, later ones with it give none.
bonuses: The Batoten is its own Mastery entry on top of the Model.
